verdict.rationale: Porkbun docs confirm portfolio-wide auto-renewal control (docs-17) and webhook events for 'upcoming expirations' and renewals (docs-8, docs-33), covering the auto-renew and expiry-notice parts of the story. However, there is no documented grace/redemption window policy (post-expiration recovery periods) anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit grace/redemption window documentation, per-domain (vs portfolio-only) auto-renew toggle detail, and independent confirmation that expiry webhooks/notices are reliable in practice.
